subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Should OpenClaw accept allowlisted github.com and single-label *.ghe.com host routing inside the bundled github-copilot provider, including the new config/env inputs and token-cache domain boundary?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but it changes where provider credentials can be exchanged and adds persistent/provider-facing routing surface, which requires maintainer intent beyond automated code review.

options.title: Accept narrow bundled-provider GHE routing
options.body: Approve this provider-owned host-routing path after maintainer/security review, preserving the fail-closed allowlist, domain-stamped cache, tests, docs, and live proof.

options.title: Require a generic host-routing contract first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define a reusable provider-auth host-routing API and then adapt the implementation to that contract.

options.title: Keep GHE Copilot external
options.body: Close or redirect the PR if maintainers decide GHE data-residency Copilot should remain a ClawHub/plugin direction rather than bundled-provider behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow bundled-provider GHE routing
recommendation.body: Approve this provider-owned host-routing path after maintainer/security review, preserving the fail-closed allowlist, domain-stamped cache, tests, docs, and live proof.
